```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape)
library(psych)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(magrittr)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggplot2)  
library(dplyr)  
library(ggpmisc)
library(ggsci)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

col_pool = c("#F59B7B", "#ED8828", "#A4DDD3", "#81B21F","#8D73BA","#EFB04B",
              "#ABD7EC","#33ABC1", "#FCC41E", "#B6BBBD", "#8FB4DC", "#EB7E60")

col_pla_env = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")
col_pla_other = c("#8FB4DC", "#EFB04B")
col_site = c("#F59B7B", "#ED8828", "#B6BBBD","#8D73BA","#FCC41E","#8FB4DC")
col_link_type <- c("#EB7E60", "#C6EAE3", "#8FB4DC")
LOG_TRANSFORM <- FALSE  
col_site <- setNames(col_site, c("Reserve", "Beach", "Port", "Mariculture", "Estuary", "WWTP"))
site_levels <- names(col_site)

```


```{r}
env <- read.csv('envdata.csv', row.names = 1)
spe <- read.csv('multi_risks_01scaled.csv',  row.names = 1)
pp <- corr.test(env,spe,method="pearson",adjust = "fdr")
cor <- pp$r

pvalue <- matrix(p.adjust(pp$p, method = "fdr"), nrow = nrow(pp$p), dimnames = dimnames(pp$p))

df <- melt(cor) %>% mutate(pvalue=melt(pvalue)[,3],
                           p_signif=symnum(pvalue, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE,
                                           cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
                                           symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "", " "))) %>%
  set_colnames(c("env","risk","r","p","p_signif"))

p3a <- df %>%
  ggplot(.,aes(env, risk, col=r,fill=r))+
  geom_tile(color="grey80",fill="white",size=0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(size =abs(r),col=r),shape=21) +
  geom_text(aes(label=p_signif),size= 4,color="black",hjust=0.5,vjust=0.7)+
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = rev(col_link_type)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(col_link_type),
                       breaks=c(0.4,0.2,0,-0.2),
                       guide=guide_legend(range = c(1,6),direction="vertical",
                                          theme = theme(legend.key.spacing.y= unit(1.32,"cm"),
                                                        legend.text = element_blank(),
                                                        legend.margin = margin(c(2,-1.2,1,0),unit="cm")))) +


  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0), position = 'top')+

  scale_y_discrete(expand=c(0,0), position = 'left') +

  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle =45,hjust = 0,vjust = 0,
                                 color="black", size = 8),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color="black",size =8),
        axis.ticks= element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.box.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_size(range=c(1,6),guide=NULL)


p3a

```


```{r}

data <- read.csv("Pla_risk_&_Anthropogenic_Impact.csv")

microbial_risks <- c('Pathogenic_bacteria', 'Pathogenic_fungi', 'Toxic_algae', 'ARGs')

env_data <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c('Pollution_level'), names_to = "Environmental_Factor", values_to = "Environmental_Value")

microbial_data <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(microbial_risks), names_to = "Microbial_Risk", values_to = "Microbial_Value")

plot_data <- merge(env_data, microbial_data, by = c("SampleID", "group"))

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Environmental_Factor, Microbial_Risk, group) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(Microbial_Value ~ Environmental_Value, data = .)
    data.frame(., p_value = summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4])
  }) %>%
  mutate(linetype = ifelse(p_value < 1, "dashed", "solid")) %>%
  ungroup()

p3b <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Environmental_Value, y = Microbial_Value, color = group, linetype = linetype)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +

  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', formula = y ~ x, se = F,
              aes(color = group, fill = group), show.legend = F, linewidth = 0.5) +

  stat_poly_eq(aes(label = ifelse(..p.value.. > 1, "", paste(..rr.label.., stat(p.value.label), sep = '~~~'))),
               formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE,
               label.x.npc = 'right', label.y.npc = 'top', size = 2) +

  facet_wrap(~Microbial_Risk, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B", "#81B21F")) +

  theme_bw() +

  labs(x = 'Polluted level', y = 'Microbial Risk') +

  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor=element_blank()) +

  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill=c("#FFF6E1")))+

  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7,colour = "#B8733A"))

p3b

```


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

data <- read.csv("Anthropogenic_Impact_Index.csv")

summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_Pollution_level = mean(Pollution_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_Pollution_level = sd(Pollution_level, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_data$Site <- factor(summary_data$Site,
                            levels = c("Reserve", "Beach", "Port", "Mariculture", "Estuary", "WWTP"))


p3c <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Site, y = mean_Pollution_level, color = Site)) +

  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) + 

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_Pollution_level - se_Pollution_level,
                    ymax = mean_Pollution_level + se_Pollution_level),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0) +

  scale_color_manual(values = col_site) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

p3c

```


```{r}

data <- read.csv("pla_multi_risks.csv")
data$Site <- factor(data$Site, levels = site_levels) 

tf_abund <- if (LOG_TRANSFORM) log10 else identity
tf_fc    <- if (LOG_TRANSFORM) log2  else identity

data_zscore <- data %>%
  group_by(Risk_type) %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance_z   = as.numeric(scale(tf_abund(Abundance))),  
    Fold_change_z = as.numeric(scale(tf_fc(Fold_change)))   
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

summary_data <- data_zscore %>%
  group_by(Risk_type, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance_mean = mean(Abundance_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Fold_change_mean = mean(Fold_change_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundance_se = sd(Abundance_z, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Fold_change_se = sd(Fold_change_z, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


lim_d1 <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(Risk_type) %>%
  summarise(xl = max(abs(Abundance_mean) + Abundance_se, na.rm = TRUE),
            yl = max(abs(Fold_change_mean) + Fold_change_se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
blank_d1 <- bind_rows(transmute(lim_d1, Risk_type, x = -xl, y = -yl),
                      transmute(lim_d1, Risk_type, x =  xl, y =  yl))


p3d <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Abundance_mean, y = Fold_change_mean, color = Site)) +

  geom_blank(data = blank_d1, aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Fold_change_mean - Fold_change_se,
                    ymax = Fold_change_mean + Fold_change_se),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Abundance_mean - Abundance_se,
                     xmax = Abundance_mean + Abundance_se),
                 height = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#688899", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#315B65", linewidth = 0.5) +

  facet_wrap(~Risk_type, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +

  theme_minimal() +

  scale_color_manual(values = col_site) +

  labs(x = "Abundance",  y = "Enrichment fold", color = "Site") +

  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

p3d

```


```{r}

data <- read.csv("pla_multi_risks.csv")
data$Site <- factor(data$Site, levels = site_levels)  

tf_abund <- if (LOG_TRANSFORM) log10 else identity
tf_rich  <- if (LOG_TRANSFORM) log10 else identity

data_zscore <- data %>%
  group_by(Risk_type) %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance_z  = as.numeric(scale(tf_abund(Abundance))),  
    Richness_z   = as.numeric(scale(tf_rich(Richness)))     
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

summary_data <- data_zscore %>%
  group_by(Risk_type, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance_mean = mean(Abundance_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Richness_mean = mean(Richness_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundance_se = sd(Abundance_z, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Richness_se = sd(Richness_z, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lim_d2 <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(Risk_type) %>%
  summarise(xl = max(abs(Abundance_mean) + Abundance_se, na.rm = TRUE),
            yl = max(abs(Richness_mean) + Richness_se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
blank_d2 <- bind_rows(transmute(lim_d2, Risk_type, x = -xl, y = -yl),
                      transmute(lim_d2, Risk_type, x =  xl, y =  yl))


p3e <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Abundance_mean, y = Richness_mean, color = Site)) +

  geom_blank(data = blank_d2, aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Richness_mean - Richness_se, ymax = Richness_mean + Richness_se),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Abundance_mean - Abundance_se, xmax = Abundance_mean + Abundance_se),
                 height = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#8A9B6D", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#315B65", linewidth = 0.5) +

  facet_wrap(~Risk_type, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +

  theme_minimal() +

  scale_color_manual(values = col_site) +

  labs(x = "Abundance",y = "Richness", color = "Site") +

  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

p3e

```
